functions.description: Parse base crond syslog structure: timestamp, host, process, pid, message
Extract user, job pid, and command from standard crond job execution lines
Extract user and crontab file path from crontab load/reload events
Extract exit status code from command completion messages
Classify severity and action based on crond message content

add.name: severity
add.value: message.match(/SUSPICIOUS COMMAND/) ? 'critical' : message.match(/ERROR/) ? 'error' : message.match(/WARNING/) ? 'warning' : message.match(/FAILED/) ? 'error' : message.match(/PERMISSION DENIED/) ? 'warning' : 'info'

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/SUSPICIOUS COMMAND/) ? 'blocked' : message.match(/FAILED/) ? 'failure' : message.match(/PERMISSION DENIED/) ? 'denied' : message.match(/cannot fork process/) ? 'error' : exit_status === '0' ? 'success' : exit_status ? 'failure' : 'executed'
